figures.caption: Killing kinetics of YZ105 against Staphylococcus aureus USA300 LAC. figures.caption: Membrane permeabilization of Staphylococcus aureus USA300 in PBS by YZ103 (16 μM), YZ105 (4 μM), nafcillin (2 μM), linezolid (16 μM), and LL‐37 (16 μM), all at 4 × MIC, in the presence of 20 μM propidium iodide. YZ105 (green line) is even more powerful than LL‐37 (pink line)
figures.label: FIGURE 3

figures.caption: Membrane depolarization of Staphylococcus aureus USA300 by YZ105, nafcillin, linezolid and triton X‐100 (1%). Nonmembrane targeting antibiotics were used as negative controls.
